question: Independent check: projection norms of the source charge q onto the D5 and A3 factors of the honest dressed clock, against the determinant-only packet formula.
summary_de: E8_c: (6,2) fuer alle Kleidungen und Lifts; kein Determinanten-Paket liefert Familiennorm 2. Mit erhaltener Komposition C=g^2 quadrieren alle g-Lifts (Differenz in D8*/D8, Exponent 2) auf denselben Toruspunkt: s (4,4), c (6,2); (8,0) nur unabhaengiger C-Kontrolllift. s-Lemma: Familiennorm 4 = t^2(sum m^2-1) erzwingt |t|=2, m_A, ohne Einheits-Clutching; Traegerrichtung offen. SU(2)_1-Dublett-Buchhaltung bestaetigt.
kills: The c-chiral extension passes the joint clock/source-charge/packet projection test for some integral carrier direction
The (8,0) control lift is a square of the original g action
The minimal packet m_A needs the unit-clutch identification once C = g^2 in E8_s is granted
assumptions: Determinant-only packet formula with integral carrier U(1) cocharacter
Clock centraliser factors A3 (family) and D5 (carrier) as in the honest dressed fold clock
not_derived: Raw E8 algebra in the source
